'''Kaltho''' was a wealthy [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] from a prominent [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidic]]. His immense fortune was gained from daily intake of hundreds of thousands of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] earned through his ownership of many large [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and [[Hangar/Legends|loading docks]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. His vast holdings allowed him to also branch into [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], [[Arms dealer/Legends|weapons dealing]] and dealing in the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade.

==History==
At some time during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kaltho traveled to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to participate in an auction for the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], a valuable [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca gem]]. He traveled with a large retinue of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] and [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] guards, servants, bookkeepers and his chief enforcer, [[Kerek]].
